title: Income Tax Act 2023 Section 170 – Tax VAT Point
main_content: Section 170 - Obligation to File Self Assessment Return (1) All such persons subject to statutory obligation to file return under section 166 shall file return in self-assessment mode under section 180: Provided that companies other than one person companies, banks, insurance and financial institutions and individuals leaving in Bangladesh can file ordinary returns. (2) For the purposes of this section, “Normal Return” means a return filed for assessment of tax under section 183 or 184.
